name: Citadel: Sanctum
summary: The inner sanctum of the Muramite Citadel, where arcane specialists and war councils operate.
description: The Citadel Sanctum is the arcane and strategic heart of the Muramite Citadel Complex. Discord priests, arcane specialists, and sanctum wardens maintain wards, conduits, and ritual chambers. War councils convene here to plan operations across Kuua. The Sanctum is heavily guarded, with layered wards, fortified chambers, and Discord‑infused architecture. Resistance infiltration is rare and extremely dangerous.
